name: Phear Park Play Area
description: Exmouth's main town park play area, run by East Devon District Council. It is being rebuilt by Kompan: work was due to start in mid-September 2026 and take about two months, with a four-metre oak-tree climbing unit, a large squirrel play unit and owl touches, including one set into the trampoline surfacing. The multi-use games area is being renewed and a wheeled-sports area and pump track added next to the skate park.
